She is an international conference speaker and teacher trainer. She has a DIP TESOL certification and is a part of the Academic Support Team of Trinity College London. An MBA in Finance from NMIMS Mumbai, she has corporate finance experience of 12 years.

b: Speaker Urmi Bajpai is Professor, Department of Biomedical Science, Acharya Narendra Dev College, University of Delhi, where she leads the Anti-Mycobacterial Drug Discovery Laboratory. With a focus on the One Health…
f: Speaker Urmi Bajpai is Professor, Department of Biomedical Science, Acharya Narendra Dev College, University of Delhi, where she leads the Anti-Mycobacterial Drug Discovery Laboratory. With a focus on the One Health approach, which links human, animal, and environmental health, she advocates for a broader and more integrated response to Anti-Microbial Resistance. She promotes awareness of their potential as “living antibiotics” and biocontrol agents through talks, interactive sessions, writing popular-science articles, and hosting hands-on workshops. Her contributions to science and education have earned her several prestigious awards, including recognition among India’s “35 Vigyan Vidushis” by the Department of Science & Technology, Government of India.

b: Festival Director Usha Raman is a writer and media studies scholar. Her writing, which spans the academic and the popular, has appeared in multiple media outlets and includes three co-edited volumes and a co-authored…
f: Festival Director Usha Raman is a writer and media studies scholar. Her writing, which spans the academic and the popular, has appeared in multiple media outlets and includes three co-edited volumes and a co-authored book. She edits a magazine for schoolteachers, Teacher Plus . She has published a collection of poetry, All the Spaces in Between (2009), and a novel, Polite Conversations (2024). Amita R Desai Festival Director Tejah Balantrapu Festival Director Vijay Kumar Tadakamalla Festival Director

b: Speaker Utkarsh is an MA student at The EFL University, Hyderabad, and a trained Hindustani classical vocalist. He worked as an assistant teacher in the USA and wants to pursue a career in education.
f: Speaker Utkarsh is an MA student at The EFL University, Hyderabad, and a trained Hindustani classical vocalist. He worked as an assistant teacher in the USA and wants to pursue a career in education.

b: Speaker Vaishali BK is an educator, TEDx speaker, parent coach, and author with a background in Montessori and special education. She leads workshops on parenting, emotional regulation, and early learning for schools…
f: Speaker Vaishali BK is an educator, TEDx speaker, parent coach, and author with a background in Montessori and special education. She leads workshops on parenting, emotional regulation, and early learning for schools and global communities. Her books include the nature-rooted Mammas in the Wild (2021) and Pappas in the Wild (2021), SEL favourites like Vendhu Thanindhathu Kovam (2024), Anger: From Storm to Calm (2025), and Amma’s Magic Handbag (2024). Through her community Ammatoday, her writing, and her reading circles, she works towards raising a world filled with curious, compassionate children (and adults!).

b: Speaker Vandana Vasudevan graduated from the Indian Institute of Management, Ahmedabad, and worked in the corporate sector for many years. She shifted career tracks and became a development sector professional,…
f: Speaker Vandana Vasudevan graduated from the Indian Institute of Management, Ahmedabad, and worked in the corporate sector for many years. She shifted career tracks and became a development sector professional, consulting for various national and international organizations after obtaining a PhD in urban development from the University of Grenoble, France. She is the author of Urban Villager: Life In An Indian Satellite Town (2013), Tough Customer (2014), and OTP Please: Online Buyers, Sellers and Gig Workers in South Asia (2025). She has written extensively for mainstream newspapers and was a columnist for several years for Mint and DNA .

b: Speaker Varaprasad Reddy is best known as the founder of Shantha Biotechnics Ltd., the first biopharma company in the country, in 1993. As a pioneering scientist and engineer, he received many prestigious awards,…
f: Speaker Varaprasad Reddy is best known as the founder of Shantha Biotechnics Ltd., the first biopharma company in the country, in 1993. As a pioneering scientist and engineer, he received many prestigious awards, including the Padma Bhushan (2005), the YSR Life Time Achievement Award (2022), and the Lifetime Achievement Award from BioSpectrum in recognition of his contributions to the Indian biopharma and biotechnology sector. Shantha Biotechnics is the first Indian company to develop, manufacture, and market recombinant human healthcare products in India, including the first indigenous r-DNA Hepatitis B vaccine, and several other high-end vaccines and drugs of international standards made available at an affordable price.

b: Speaker Varsha Sharma is an anchor and host at Doordarshan Hyderabad. She is also a poet and was invited by All India Radio, DRDL, CDFD, Steel Authority of India, and Kendriya Hindi Sansthan. She is an Advisory Board…
f: Speaker Varsha Sharma is an anchor and host at Doordarshan Hyderabad. She is also a poet and was invited by All India Radio, DRDL, CDFD, Steel Authority of India, and Kendriya Hindi Sansthan. She is an Advisory Board Member Vaak Foundation, and contributed to Major Dhyanchand Khel Ratna Kavya Sarovar , a unique collection of poems on 55 Khel Ratna awardees, which was recognized by the Golden Book of World Records in 2022 and also earned the appreciation of President Ramnath Kovind. She received Kavya bhaskar and Kavya maneeshi awards, and was nominated for the CBS Stree Shakti Award (2023).

b: Speaker Vasamalli Kurtaz, a member of the Toda community, has worked towards the development of the tribal people in Nilgiris, with a focus on language, land rights, and cultural preservation. She has contributed to the…
f: Speaker Vasamalli Kurtaz, a member of the Toda community, has worked towards the development of the tribal people in Nilgiris, with a focus on language, land rights, and cultural preservation. She has contributed to the creation of a Toda Dictionary, a project led by Peri Bhaskararao and Masato Kobayashi, and has co-authored with Karthick Narayanan Maarum Ulagil Maraya Oligal (2017), a translated compilation of songs and stories from the Toda language into Tamil. She is a member of the Sahitya Akademi and the Adi Dravidar Tribal Welfare Committee and Peace Committee in Nilgiris District. She received the SPARROW-R Thyagarajan Literary Award 2024 for her contribution to language and literature.

b: Speaker Venugopala Rao Kaki is a former Lecturer in English and an Indian English writer. He has published poems, short stories, critical articles in anthologies and print and e-journals such as Poet , Poetry Times ,…
f: Speaker Venugopala Rao Kaki is a former Lecturer in English and an Indian English writer. He has published poems, short stories, critical articles in anthologies and print and e-journals such as Poet , Poetry Times , Poets International , The Indian Pen , Poet Crit , Poetry World , Triveni , Literary Criterion , Contemporary Vibes , Amaravati Poetic Prism , Muse India , and Poem Hunter.com. He is the author of two books of poetry, Ripples and Reflections (2016) and The Muse Beckons (2012). He has also published several articles in national newspapers like The Hindu , The New Indian Express, Deccan Herald , and Hans India .

b: Festival Director Dr Vijay Kumar Tadakamalla currently teaches literatures in English at BITS Pilani, Hyderabad. Formerly, he was Professor and Head, Department of English, and Dean, Faculty of Arts, Osmania University,…
f: Festival Director Dr Vijay Kumar Tadakamalla currently teaches literatures in English at BITS Pilani, Hyderabad. Formerly, he was Professor and Head, Department of English, and Dean, Faculty of Arts, Osmania University, Hyderabad. His publications include critical studies: Indian Languages in the Diaspora (2021), English and Other International Languages (2018), and translations from Telugu: The Liberation of Sita (2016, 2018) by Volga and Kanyasulkam (2002) by Gurajada Venkata Appa Rao. He is TEDx speaker and a Founder Editor of Muse India: the literary ejournal . Amita R Desai Festival Director B Kinnera Murthy Festival Director Usha Raman Festival Director

b: Speaker Vikhar Ahmed Sayeed is a journalist currently working as a Senior Deputy Editor at Frontline magazine. In his 17 years at this magazine devoted to long-form journalism, he has reported on diverse themes…
f: Speaker Vikhar Ahmed Sayeed is a journalist currently working as a Senior Deputy Editor at Frontline magazine. In his 17 years at this magazine devoted to long-form journalism, he has reported on diverse themes including politics, communalism, gender, rural and urban deprivation, agriculture, caste, environment, literature, cinema, history, and music. His video documentary Together We Sing (2024) on the syncretic celebrations that mark Muharram in north Karnataka won the Human Rights and Religious Freedom Journalism Award (2025) in the category of Best Story on Human Solidarity.

b: Speaker Vimee Bindra is a distinguished robotic and laparoscopic gynaecologist with over 15 years of experience in women’s health. She is internationally recognized for her expertise in minimally invasive excision…
f: Speaker Vimee Bindra is a distinguished robotic and laparoscopic gynaecologist with over 15 years of experience in women’s health. She is internationally recognized for her expertise in minimally invasive excision surgery for endometriosis, with a strong focus on complex and deep infiltrating disease, nerve-sparing techniques, and fertility-preserving approaches. Widely regarded as one of India’s leading endometriosis surgeons, she is currently a Consultant Gynaecologist at Apollo Hospitals, Hyderabad. She is the Founder and Director of the Advanced Centre for PCOS and Endometriosis (COPE), and the Founder and President of the Endometriosis Foundation of India (EFI)—a national platform committed to advancing awareness, education, research, and advocacy for endometriosis care across India.
